name: New Horde
summary: Across Kalimdor and Lordaeron, the New Horde seeks a home and allies under warchief thrall. Orcs, Darkspear trolls, and tauren join in shamanic tradition, honor, and mutual survival, while a wary pact binds them to the Forsaken.

sections.title: A Legacy Reborn
sections.body: The first Horde was forged by the Burning Legion and the Shadow Council as a weapon. Demonic bloodlust drove the orcs through the Dark Portal. After the Second War ended in ruin, the Alliance confined surviving orcs in internment camps, where they sank into soul-draining lethargy. Orgrim Doomhammer, Grommash Hellscream, and the young shaman Thrall helped the orcs break their demonic shackles. They reclaimed their ancestral shamanism and fought their way to freedom.

sections.title: Crossing the Great Sea
sections.body: Guided by visions from the mysterious Prophet, Thrall led his people across the Great Sea to Kalimdor. Along the way, they welcomed the displaced Darkspear trolls of Sen'jin. On Kalimdor, Thrall joined Cairne Bloodhoof and the nomadic tauren to drive back hostile centaur tribes. Together with humans and night elves, they fought at Mount Hyjal and broke the Burning Legion's invasion. Then they made their home in Durotar.

sections.title: The Modern Coalition
sections.body: From their fortified capital of Orgrimmar, the New Horde works to build a lasting society. Orcs, Darkspear trolls, and tauren share strong bonds, while the need to survive has drawn Thrall into uneasy alliances. One binds him to Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken in the ruins of Lordaeron. Thrall seeks peace with the Alliance, yet old enmities, scarce resources, and hawkish voices on both sides keep the borders close to war.

faq.q: What makes the New Horde different from the Old Horde?
faq.answer: The Old Horde served demonic corruption, dark warlocks, and brutal conquest in the First and Second Wars. Thrall founded the New Horde in rejection of the Burning Legion. It restored the orcs' shamanic roots and embraced honor, cultural survival, and self-determination.

Thrall, son of Durotan, leads the New Horde as warchief. From the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar, he works in close council with high chieftain cairne bloodhoof of the tauren and Shadow Hunter Vol'jin of the Darkspear trolls.

faq.q: Which races belong to the New Horde right now?
faq.answer: The New Horde's core is made up of orcs, the Darkspear tribe of trolls, and the tauren of Mulgore. In the Eastern Kingdoms, the undead Forsaken under lady sylvanas windrunner belong through a pragmatic military alliance.

faq.q: Why did the Forsaken join the New Horde?
faq.answer: Surrounded by the Scarlet Crusade, hostile humans, and Scourge remnants, Sylvanas Windrunner sought powerful allies to survive. The tauren, led by Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem, spoke for the Forsaken in Orgrimmar because they believed the Forsaken could be redeemed. Their appeal convinced Thrall to accept a mutual pact of convenience.

faq.q: Are the orcs still corrupted by demon blood?
faq.answer: No. Grommash Hellscream and Thrall faced the pit lord Mannoroth in Ashenvale. Grom struck the demon down at the cost of his own life, breaking the blood curse and freeing every orc from demonic enslavement.

faq.q: Is the New Horde currently at war with the Alliance?
aliases: are horde and alliance at war
faq.answer: The uneasy truce between Thrall and Lady Jaina Proudmoore of Theramore keeps open war in check. Skirmishes still rage across Ashenvale, Alterac Valley, and the Arathi Basin. Mistrust and disputes over resources threaten to spark open conflict.

angles.text: The New Horde offers outcasts sanctuary, mutual defense, and a chance to preserve their cultures. Its members share an oath of honor under warchief thrall.
Many in the Alliance remember the bloodshed of the First and Second Wars. They still doubt that orcs can leave their violent past behind.
As an orc, you find redemption and freedom from the lethargy of the internment camps in the New Horde. You can honor Grom Hellscream's sacrifice and live as a free shamanic warrior.
As a shaman, you follow the New Horde's spiritual backbone. Shamanism renews ancient traditions that connect mortals with the elements, traditions nearly lost to demonic corruption.
